lines.text: Everyone still talks about that trend!
That trend is old. I'm over it.

data.define: Used when you no longer care or enjoy something.

example.text: That trend is old. I'm over it.

misuse.text: Don't say 'I'm over it' while still crying.
misuse.why: Your words and feelings won't match.

hook.text: Everyone still talks about that trend!

publish.title: What does "I'm over it" mean?
publish.value: I'm over it = I'm tired of this. Example: "That trend is old. I'm over it." (casual English).
